content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to lift heavy. Muscle growth comes from taking sets close to failure, about 0-3 reps left in the tank. That works with loads from roughly 30% to 85% of your 1RM, as long as the effort is high and your weekly volume adds up.

💡 For you, though, the 100 kg bench goal is a strength goal. Heavier work in the 3-8 rep range will help it most, and you can use lighter sets for extra volume.
